name: Three Futures / Counterfactual Recovery System
purpose: Visual language for candidate generation, policy evaluation, rejection, selection, and convergence.

rules.candidateCount: Support 1–3 real candidates. Never fabricate absent futures.
rules.selectedRoute: Forest green, stronger stroke, optional brass progress marker.
rules.rejectedRoute: Sage/de-emphasized route; failure/rust localized to terminal rejection state.
rules.cards: DOM in production; SVG cards in exports are visual references only.
rules.responsive: Inline SVG should be generated from measured anchors rather than stretching fixed exports.
rules.truth: Reference screenshots are composition references, not proof data. Real backend may produce 3 valid candidates.
